master: Master Sheet v1; original character/guardian/environment references; 8-swatch palette and line hierarchy. Latest Notion 4 guardians, personalization and cumulative original skill inheritance.
common: K4RMA assets, exactly matching the Master Art Direction Sheet reference and original uploaded design references. Do not redesign characters. Clean hand-drawn ink contours, two-tone shading, minimal internal hatch, navy indigo dark teal subdued background, ivory pale moonlight VFX. Hero exact black tied hair, same face and body, navy short sleeve training jacket, dark hakama, ivory belt, katana. Guardians wooden plank swordsman/navy cords, agile longlimbed wooden machine/teal cloth/upward fins, massive round-shield wooden tank. Outer contour twice inner line. VFX one large elongated confidently tapered ivory crescent brush, narrow pale blue/gold fringe, no particle clouds. Original three skills sword wave / rising blade / guard; personalization 고유화 transforms them to piercing cut / air suspend / riposte; original traces accumulate in guardians, 4 trials, final guardian all three. All game terminology 고유화. No mentor boss, no fantasy Chinese ornament, no Hollow Knight characters, no overly chibi or cinematic painterly redesign.

VFX.name: player-attack-vfx
VFX.spec: Create transparent 4-column 3-row isolated PLAYER VFX atlas, NO characters labels grid ground shadows. Each cell a distinctly readable full effect, margins so strokes never meet. Row1 basic horizontal slash pointing right, stronger wider horizontal slash right, long horizontal crescent projectile right, huge vertical rising crescent up. Row2 airborne rising crescent, parry success sharp small radial diamond flash, thin guard semicircle right, concentric full guard rings. Row3 guard collision a tiny concentrated spark on right ring edge, long guard riposte slash, piercing-cut long straight tapered trail, air-suspend gentle hooked crescent. Slash forms ivory white solid core confidently taper from hairline origin toward broad crescent, VERY LARGE clear strokes, pale blue barely visible fringe, only 2-3 tiny fragments. Guard pale ivory gold thin concentric circles. No background lighting baked in. Pure standalone effects.

VFX.name: guardian-attack-vfx
VFX.spec: Create transparent 4-column 3-row isolated GUARDIAN VFX atlas, NO characters labels grid ground shadows. Row1 boss horizontal slash LEFT, long crescent wave projectile LEFT, massive upward rising crescent, broad downward landing crescent. Row2 giant thin round ward barrier, compressed barrier collision right edge, giant horizontal ward riposte LEFT, airborne wave angled down LEFT. Row3 rising plus horizontal combination shape, horizontal wave framed by thin defense semicircle, vertical rising blade through defense ring, subtle horizontal attack anticipation line. Same ivory white tapered brush and pale blue/gold fringe as player, scale and elongated proportions signal danger, no particle explosion. Effects fill their separate cells without touching.

VFX.name: hit-vfx
VFX.spec: Create transparent clean 4-column 2-row isolated HIT VFX atlas. NO characters text grid environments. Row2 3 wooden chips no dust cloud, small contact spark, guardian core flicker thin ring, tiny landing crescent of moon dust. Compact near-white center pale gold/blue borders. All strokes coherent with master moon brush. Nothing resembling fireworks.

UI.name: ui-hud-icons-atlas
UI.spec: A transparent production UI GRAPHICS ATLAS with separate uncluttered components, NO background scene NO text NO letters. Ivory hairline ink only except navy translucent panel. Layout 4 columns 4 rows with generous empty margins. Row1 three SKILL ICONS horizontal tapered crescent / upward vertical crescent / two concentric rings; fourth a small diamond focus cursor. Row2 three PERSONALIZED icons forward piercing sword line / suspended hooked crescent / counterstrike spark crescent; fourth a simple checkmark. Row3 slim elegant player HP bar empty ivory border then separate ivory fill strip; long boss HP empty bar border then separate ivory fill strip. Row4 dark navy translucent selection panel with subtly curved ornamental corners and thin ivory hairline, tiny divider line with center diamond, three little inherited skill circles in a strip, simple disabled diagonal slash mark.
